T1_manifest.description: Single order manifest (<order_id>.manifest.json + order['manifest']) recording input hashes, models & versions, licence IDs, seeds, parameters, retries, artifact SHA-256s, QC metrics, owner_approval hashes, and Jeff pause state; written on generating, qc, approve, and deliver.

T1_delivery_link.description: Random stdl_ delivery link with TTL and revocation; only token_sha256 stored on disk (delivery_links.json + order['delivery_link']). Revoked -> 404, expired -> 404, client B opening client A link -> 404.

T1_source_rights.description: Independent preflight and delivery gate item source_rights_missing (separate from brand clearance), with POST /api/studio/orders/{id}/source-rights and confirm_source_rights.

T1_model_licence_policy.description: Per owner decisions 24.10 & 29.10 (LANES_20261029.md §Решения владельца п.1), model licence remains an owner-only warning (licence_warnings) and does not block delivery.

T2_preset_and_qc.description: End-to-end commercial presets product_spin and hand_reveal (wan2.2-ti2v-5b, 1080x1920 >= 1080p, 24fps, 6.0s) with idempotent render key, Jeff pause state during render, contact_sheet.png + qc_report.json (Laplacian sharpness, flicker score, duration, resolution), and mid-render kill recovery via reconcile_required without duplicate jobs.

T2_mobile_studio_card.description: Mobile Pult (:8840) Studio card with preview (/m/api/studio/orders/{id}/preview), cost/margin, QC metrics, and buttons «Принять» (POST /m/api/studio/orders/{id}/approve) and «На доработку» (POST /m/api/studio/orders/{id}/rework), preserving 404/405 on quote/accept/start/deliver/cancel.
